title: Kanon by Aviator
author: AviatorX69
selftext:
**I finally finished a multiplayer castle siege game I gave up on 6 years ago!**

About six years ago, I started developing a physics-based castle siege game. The idea was simple: two players, two castles, lots of cannons and destruction!

But I ran into a problem I couldn't solve — synchronizing the physics between two players. Eventually, I gave up.

Recently, I decided to give it another shot, this time with some help from AI-assisted coding.

Instead of trying to synchronize two separate physics simulations, I came up with a different approach: the host handles all the physics, while WebRTC streams the game view to the guest and sends player inputs back to the host.

And it actually works! 😁

The result is **Kanon**, a free browser-based multiplayer game where you try to demolish your opponent's castle, cannons and defenses.

You can try it here: [https://kjelle69.itch.io/kanon](https://kjelle69.itch.io/kanon)

**AI disclosure:** I used AI-assisted coding to help develop and debug the game, including the multiplayer implementation. The promotional cover image was also AI-generated.
